title: generate_quiz
description: Generate a quiz or flashcard set from existing notes. Reads the source notes, creates study questions in the requested format, and saves them as a new flashcard-type note. Use for exam preparation, self-testing, and spaced repetition study.

source_note_ids.description: Array of note IDs (or 8-char prefixes) to generate questions from.

quiz_type.description: The format of the generated questions.

num_questions.description: Number of questions to generate. Defaults to 10 if not specified.

content.description: The generated quiz content in markdown. For flashcards use **Q:** / **A:** format separated by --- dividers. For multiple choice use **Q:** with lettered options and **Answer:** line. For fill_in_blank use sentences with ___. For true_false use **Statement:** / **Answer:** True or False.
